# Battery Specifications

## Overview
This page outlines the battery specifications and related power endurance details for the [Aurora Nova Widget](./aurora-nova-widget.md), drawing from [customer support](./customer-support.md) inquiries and official [documentation](./documentation.md) updates.

## Key Details
- **Correct Battery Type:** The official battery specification for the Aurora Nova Widget is **CR2032**. 
- **Documentation Updates:** An earlier teardown blog by Alex mistakenly listed the battery as a CR2450. This error was corrected on the blog on June 20, 2026, and the official wiki page has been updated accordingly.
- **[Power Budget](./power-budget.md) & Lifespan:** Battery longevity varies based on node count and read interval (which defaults to 15 minutes). A comprehensive power budget document is slated for upcoming publication.

## Related Entities
- **Aurora Nova Widget:** The product associated with the battery specifications.
- **Alex:** Author of the teardown blog that initially listed conflicting battery information.
- **Mira:** Support agent who clarified the correct battery specifications and documentation updates.
- **[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md):** An unrelated product and company that does not share the app with the Aurora Nova Widget.

## Related Concepts
- **Battery Specification:** The exact physical and electrical requirements of the device's power source (CR2032).
- **Power Budget:** The calculated consumption of the device based on node counts and read intervals.

## Contradictions
&gt; **Contradiction:** Marketing materials state a 2-year [battery life](./battery-life.md), whereas community forum discussions claim an 18-month lifespan. Actual longevity depends heavily on node count and read interval configurations (15-minute default).
